description: PM shift #53, 2026-11-23 04:04Z. Nothing on the agenda. Board verified truthful, one duplicate wake removed, one measurement protocol written so the 08:00Z alarm test cannot be read two ways.

messages.content:
#TL; DR;
**At risk.** Nothing was delivered overnight because nothing *can* be: every executable card needs a shell or a human, and neither is available to an AI turn. The single most valuable thing this shift could do was make the 08:00Z alarm test unambiguous — that is done, and one duplicate wake that would have polluted it is cleared. **The three human commands in `91436ae5` are still the whole critical path and are still unanswered (decision open since shift #50).**

## 1. Summary
Goal: get the M1 stability backlog draining again — security proof shipped, tests collecting, stale-lock fixed. Business outcome: an M1 increment that can be deployed and demoed rather than described. Blocker: no AI turn has an execution toolset, so no task can prove anything; every finding since shift #47 is diagnosis without hands.

## 2. Scope of this shift
In: board truthfulness, wake-channel measurement design, duplicate suppression.
Out: any code, any dispatch (`request_changes`), any re-arming of the failed experiment.

## 3. What moved
| Card | Action | Field changes | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `4a1cf260` (wake_at defect) | measurement protocol comment | none | pre-window baseline recorded for 3 ids; mechanical decision rule added; no re-arm |
| `a8e4aec1` (pytest probe) | consolidated into `91436ae5`, comment | `status`, `wake_at` (cleared) | exact command already lives in `91436ae5` §2; a third `NO-SHELL` at 20:00Z buys nothing and adds noise to the 08:00Z test |

Verified untouched (no evidence of an overnight run): `4a1cf260` `updated_at` 22 Nov 20:07:14Z · `bac1727a` 20:07:05Z · `91436ae5` 20:07:17Z.

## 4. Dependencies & critical path
`91436ae5` (human: 3 commands + 1 yes/no) → M1 security proof `c6c33374` → M1 increment deployable.
Second path: wake channel proof (`4a1cf260`, 08:00Z) → `bac1727a` (profiles threading) becomes dispatchable without a human.
Everything else on the board is downstream of one of those two.

## 5. Risks
| Risk | Impact | Prob. | Mitigation | Owner | Decision? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Human action card unanswered for 4 shifts | M1 slips indefinitely | high | one card, one paste; options already offered | human | **yes** |
| Security fix `c6c33374` ships without runtime proof | regression on every existing deployment if legacy secret fails fast | medium | hold until yes/no on Q3 answered | human + dev | **yes** |
| Wake channel dead → board cannot self-drive | shifts continue as manual reports | unknown, tested at 08:00Z | 3 ids with pre-window baseline + escalation path written | PM | no |

## 6. Decisions needed
1. Run the 3 commands in `91436ae5` + answer the rollback yes/no — decide by 23 Nov 12:00Z. (Recommended: yes, it is 5 minutes.)
2. Fix wake delivery before the dispatcher toolset (≈1 dev-day) — decide by 23 Nov 12:00Z.
3. Hold `c6c33374` until the runtime proof exists — decide by 23 Nov 12:00Z.

## 7. Next checkpoint
08:00Z: three armed ids either bump or do not — one measurement, two possible readings, both pre-decided. Report at the next shift with the result.
